Article Title: ‘How did Hockey India executive board not know?’ Congress questions govt over saffron jersey row
Article Text:
Indian hockey team players in new saffron jersey

Kharge X post

NEW DELHI: Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge on Saturday sought an explanation from the government and concerned authorities over how the men’s hockey team’s jersey colour was changed from blue to saffron allegedly without the knowledge and approval of the Hockey India executive board.Indian sports teams, including the hockey team, have traditionally worn blue as their primary colour. The decision to change the hockey team’s jersey colour has triggered a major political controversy.The change was announced on July 27, ahead of the World Cup in the Netherlands and Belgium, which begins on August 15.“National symbols, sports, and players should not be used as a medium for narrow-minded political experiments. The government and relevant institutions should immediately reconsider this decision and clarify how such an important decision was taken without the knowledge and consent of Hockey India’s executive board,” Kharge wrote in a post in Hindi on X.He further described the move as not merely a sports-related decision but one “deeply connected” to the sentiments of millions of Indians and the country’s sporting traditions.“Indian players have long been recognised around the world by names such as ‘Men in Blue’, ‘The Blues’, and ‘The Blue Tigers’. This identity is not just about the colour of the jersey, but a legacy of Indian sports. Today, it is difficult to understand why the need was felt to alter this historic identity. The question is not about any particular colour, but about the process of decision-making, transparency, and respect for public sentiments,” the Congress chief said.The veteran politician also pointed out that the colour schemes of both the national tricolour and the Congress flag comprise saffron, white, and green.Alleging the involvement of the RSS in the jersey colour change, Kharge accused the organisation — the ideological mentor of the ruling BJP — of being in a “hurry” to leave its imprint on national symbols and public institutions."It is unfortunate that those whose ideological tradition made no contribution to the freedom movement are now seen in a haste to leave their ideological imprint on every national symbol and every public institution. History knows that the RSS had staunchly opposed the tricolour, and Sardar Patel had even warned them," he added, referring to Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel, the country's first home minister and a Congress stalwart.Hockey India has defended the move, stating that the jersey’s design and colour were intended to “tell a story” and represent “India’s pride”. The federation added that the design was finalised after consultations with players and support staff.However, Hockey India president and former captain Dilip Tirkey claimed that the decision “appeared to have been taken and implemented without being placed before the executive board for discussion and without my prior knowledge.”
Article Summary: The change was announced on july 27, ahead of the world cup in the netherlands and belgium, which begins on august 15. Congress president mallikarjun kharge has sought an explanation from the government and concerned authorities. Kharge accused the rss of being in a “hurry” to leave its imprint on national symbols and public institutions.

Stephen Curry has been a lifelong Warrior but it might be over soon. Curry has spent his entire 17-year career in Golden State, but a new report suggests that could change. Sports Illustrated insider John Karalis says Boston Celtics president Brad Stevens has explored a blockbuster trade for the four-time champion, a move that would come just months after Stevens sent Jaylen Brown to Philadelphia for Paul George and draft capital. With Golden State fading and Boston searching for its next star, the idea has picked up steam even if a deal remains far from close.Stephen Curry's run with the Golden State Warriors may be nearing its end after a report from Sports Illustrated revealed the Boston Celtics have reached out about a blockbuster trade. Insider John Karalis says Celtics president Brad Stevens has been probing Golden State on a deal, just months after trading Jaylen Brown to the Philadelphia 76ers for Paul George and draft picks.The Warriors have sunk to a 10th-place finish in the West, and if Curry or Golden State lose faith in each other, Boston may find an opening. There is now talk that trade conversations have already begun.At 38, Stephen Curry remains one of the league's best guards, averaging 26.6 points, 3.6 rebounds and 4.7 assists per game last season while shooting 46.8% from the field and 39.3% from three. But the roster around him has crumbled.Jimmy Butler is still working back from a torn ACL, and Golden State leaned so hard on aging veterans that it finished 10th in the West.That decline is why speculation has crept in for the first time in the Curry era. Karalis pointed to "a crack in the foundation of the Curry-era Warriors," the first real crack of its kind since Curry arrived in the Bay Area.Boston is short a star after shipping Jaylen Brown to Philadelphia for Paul George and future picks, a swap that left much of the fan base unimpressed. Bringing in Curry alongside Jayson Tatum would give Stevens the kind of splash move that could win those fans back and put the Celtics right back into title contention.Golden State's side of the equation is different. The Warriors are not built to compete now, and if Curry or the front office start to sense that reality, moving on while his value is still high becomes a real option, even if unlikely today.Brad Stevens has already been on the phone with the Warriors brass to pitch a deal.Adding Curry gives Boston a second superstar alongside Jayson Tatum and instantly restores the Celtics as a threat in the East, even after a summer that left fans questioning the front office's direction. His shooting gravity alone would open up the floor in ways the current roster cannot match.Parting with Paul George, Sam Hauser and draft capital would sting, but Boston still holds multiple first-round picks even after this package, leaving Stevens room to keep building around his two stars.Paul George gives the Warriors a proven wing scorer to pair with their remaining pieces, even as he arrives with an uncertain long-term fit at this stage of his career. Sam Hauser adds shooting depth off the bench.The real value for Golden State would be the draft picks, giving a team that finished 10th in the West a path to restock through the draft rather than continuing to patch the roster with aging veterans.Curry, even at 38, would immediately elevate Boston's ceiling in a way Paul George, Sam Hauser and a handful of picks likely wouldn't for Golden State. It's a fair value swap on paper, but the star power tilts this toward the Celtics if it ever actually happens.

Article Title: Why Pat Freiermuth’s split-second reaction during a chaotic Steelers camp fight has fans calling him a true hero?

Pat Freiermuth created a memorable moment at Pittsburgh Steelers training camp, but it had nothing to do with a catch or a touchdown. During an autograph session near the practice field, a fight broke out among fans, and the Steelers tight end quickly stepped in when he noticed a young child standing close to the disturbance.A video from the incident shows several adults pushing and throwing punches as people nearby try to move away. Amid the confusion, Freiermuth reached over the barricade and pulled the child away from the crowd, helping the youngster avoid the dangerous situation.The incident happened during Day 4 of Steelers training camp when an autograph session became tense. According to the person who shared the footage on social media, the disagreement started among fans trying to get player signatures before turning into a physical confrontation.The fight quickly attracted attention as several people moved away from the area. However, Freiermuth’s focus went toward the child who was standing near the altercation. The Steelers tight end reacted instantly, reaching over the barrier and moving the youngster away from the crowd.The chaos was broken up soon after, and no major injuries were reported. While the altercation itself grabbed attention, fans across social media focused on Freiermuth’s reaction.Many praised him for noticing the child’s position and acting before the situation could become more serious.A fan wrote on X, “Thankfully the Steelers player pulled that kid out of the way,” highlighting how Freiermuth protected the young fan when the crowd became unpredictable.Another fan added, “Respect to Pat for taking that little kid so he doesn’t get hurt,” praising the tight end for putting someone else’s safety ahead of everything else.One more fan shared an emotional reaction to the moment, writing, “Muuuuuuuuuuuth with the grab to save the kid,” as many Steelers supporters celebrated the tight end’s awareness and quick response.Another fan added, “In all my years going to LaTrobe I have never seen that.”Some fans credited Mike Tomlin for this class act and said, “The Tomlin effect 👀”Another fan said, It's Pittsburgh...on brand. Why do you still have this Twitter? It was supposed to be DELETED LAST DECEMBER WHEN THE BROWNS BEAT THE STEELERS.The reaction from fans showed why the moment stood out. Training camp is usually a place where families gather to watch players, collect autographs, and enjoy the experience around the team. A sudden fight changed the atmosphere, but Freiermuth’s response gave fans something positive to remember.The Pittsburgh Steelers tight end has already drawn attention during camp for his performance on the field. After a challenging 2025 season, expectations are high for Freiermuth to play a bigger role in the offense, especially after the team did not make a major move at tight end following Jonnu Smith’s departure.However, this moment showed a different side of the veteran player. It was not about statistics, targets, or touchdowns. It was about awareness and making the right decision when someone needed help.Freiermuth’s action lasted only a few seconds, but it left a lasting impression. In a chaotic moment at Steelers training camp, he made sure a young fan moved away from danger, and that is why fans are celebrating him beyond the football field.

Article Title: Brock Lesnar declares future in WWE after Hell in a Cell loss to Oba Femi at SummerSlam
Article Text:
Oba Femi defeats Brock Lesnar. Image via: Rich Freeda/ WWE via Getty Images

Oba Femi defeats Brock Lesnar at SummerSlam

Brock Lesnar crowns Oba Femi as WWE's future

Brock Lesnar to be inducted into the Minnesota M Club Hall of Fame

Brock Lesnar's future in WWE took a symbolic turn at SummerSlam Night 1, where Oba Femi beat him inside Hell in a Cell to win their trilogy 2-1 and hand Lesnar his first-ever loss in the structure. The result came Saturday at U.S. Bank Stadium in Minneapolis, closing out a rivalry that began at WrestleMania 42.Moments after the bell, Lesnar grabbed a microphone and told the crowd he represents the past while Femi represents WWE's future, a rare public passing-of-the-torch moment that raised immediate questions about what comes next for The Beast Incarnate.Oba Femi beat Brock Lesnar inside Hell in a Cell at SummerSlam Night 1, closing out their three-match rivalry with a second win over The Beast Incarnate in Minneapolis. The finish came when Femi punched a steel chair out of Lesnar's hands and connected with the Fall From Grace, ending a war that had already spilled through a table, steel steps, and the exposed wood beneath the ring canvas.Lesnar opened with three German suplexes before Femi shrugged them off and tossed him outside, driving Lesnar shoulder-first into the ring steps. Lesnar answered back with steel chair shots and more suplexes, eventually tearing up the mat to expose the boards underneath and hitting a Tombstone Piledriver on the bare wood.Femi kicked out. Three F5s followed, and Femi kicked out of those too before turning the momentum for good.The loss marked the first time Lesnar had ever lost inside Hell in a Cell, a structure where he'd gone 2-0 before Saturday.The two embraced after the bell, and Lesnar called for a microphone. He told the Minneapolis crowd that he represents WWE's past and Femi represents its future, a symbolic handoff that closes out a rivalry stretching back to WrestleMania 42, where Femi's win prompted an apparent Lesnar retirement.Lesnar didn't stay retired long. He attacked Femi on Raw weeks later, then beat him in a controversial decision at WWE Clash in Italy to force the rubber match. Femi, fresh off winning the 2026 King of the Ring, gave up an earned title opportunity to instead settle things with Lesnar inside the Cell, a decision that paid off with Saturday's win.Away from SummerSlam, the University of Minnesota announced Lesnar as part of its 2026 M Club Hall of Fame class, with induction set for Oct. 2 at Huntington Bank Stadium.Lesnar wrestled at Minnesota from 1998 to 2000, going 55-3 with 23 pins and winning the 2000 NCAA heavyweight title after finishing as runner-up the year before. He'll be honored at the Gophers' Oct. 3 football game against Michigan, closing out a fall that already saw him hand the WWE torch to Oba Femi in the ring he once dominated as an amateur star just miles from campus.
Article Summary: Oba femi beat brock lesnar inside hell in a cell at summerslam night 1. The result closes out their three-match rivalry with a second win over the beast incarnate. The university of minnesota announced lesnar as part of its 2026 m club hall of fame class.

Article Title: DeAndre Hopkins isn't retiring, but can he still play in the NFL while coaching at Georgia Tech?
Article Text:
DeAndre Hopkins has confirmed he is not retiring. Source: Imagn Images

DeAndre Hopkins shuts down retirement rumors: What's next for the five-time Pro Bowl WR after his latest NFL message?

So where could Hopkins actually end up playing?

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

DeAndre Hopkins just took a job coaching wide receivers at Georgia Tech, and naturally, everyone assumed that meant retirement. He shut that down almost instantly. The five-time All-Pro is still a free agent hunting for his 14th NFL season, even while teaching college kids the same routes he's run his entire career. So the real question isn't whether he's done or whether a guy coaching on Saturdays can realistically still suit up on Sundays, and if so, who's actually going to sign him.Georgia Tech head coach Brent Key announced Hopkins' hire as assistant wide receivers coach on Friday.Hopkins didn't wait long to clarify what it meant for his NFL future. On August 1, he posted on X, "I Haven't retired from the @NFL... But if you're a WR and you want to be great, come to @GeorgiaTechFB."He's treating the coaching role as a side gig while he waits for a team to call, not as his next full-time chapter. He's got a built-in connection to the program too, through offensive coordinator George Godsey, who coached him back with the Houston Texans.This isn't even his first coaching detour this offseason. Before Georgia Tech, Hopkins spent time with the New England Patriots during their training camp, working under his old Titans head coach Mike Vrabel just to get a feel for coaching.None of it has stopped him from insisting he wants to play. Back in June, he said flatly that he still has "a lot of ball left" in him.Right now, nowhere. He's still unsigned heading into the 2026 season, and camps are already underway around the league. But his name has floated around plenty of contenders all offseason.He's said he wants Joe Burrow throwing him the ball, hinting at Cincinnati as a dream fit alongside Ja'Marr Chase and Tee Higgins. The Bills, Vikings, and even a reunion with the Chiefs, where he made a Super Bowl run in 2024 before signing with Baltimore instead, have all come up. The 49ers and Bears have also been mentioned as teams that could use a steady veteran hand.The problem is timing. With training camps already rolling and Hopkins now juggling a coaching job, a Week 1 deal looks unlikely.The more realistic path is a team scooping him up midseason once injuries start piling up at receiver, the way it's played out for him before.At 34, with declining production and a market full of other aging free agents like Stefon Diggs and Keenan Allen, Hopkins isn't short on options, he's short on urgency from teams willing to pay for a specialist role. For now, he's Georgia Tech's newest assistant coach with an NFL jersey still hanging in the closet, waiting for the right call.
Article Summary: Deandre hopkins has confirmed he is not retiring. The five-time all-pro is still a free agent hunting for his 14th nfl season. He's treating the coaching role as a side gig while he waits for a team to call, not as his next full-time chapter.

Article Title: Jake Dennis on taking the championship lead: “It's going to be an incredible fight with the five of us”
Article Text:
Jake Dennis at Tokyo E-Prix. (Image credit: Instagram)

Jake Dennis on becoming the new Formula E championship leader



Jake Dennis on securing another podium at the Tokyo E-Prix



Andretti driver Jake Dennis enjoyed a strong run in China this season, with three podiums in four races. After securing a podium in Shanghai, he went on to claim podium finishes on both days of the Tokyo E-Prix this weekend. While he finished second in Round 14, he claimed another podium by finishing third in Round 15. With this run of results, Dennis moved to the top of the Drivers' Standings. Just two more races remain before either Dennis, Mitch Evans or Pascal Wehrlein claims the world championship this season.Formula E dedicated a post to Dennis, which read: “There’s a new Championship leader. Jake Dennis heads to the London E-Prix on top of the Drivers’ World Championship standings.”On taking the lead from Mitch Evans in the Drivers' Standings, Dennis said, “Championship leader sounds incredible! I had this pressure back in Season 9, so I'm used to it. There's no difference there. Obviously, the gap is much closer, but you know, I'm just fully motivated, focused to get the job done, and it's going to be an incredible fight with the five of us who can probably go for it. There's no one I'd rather have backing my corner than Andretti, and let’s go and get it done in a couple of weeks.When asked about how he managed to claim a podium on Sunday, Jake Dennis said, “I think at one point I was 35 seconds back from the leader and to almost win it with no safety car or anything is pretty impressive. You know we got the call perfectly on the strategy with the tyre pressures and ultimately I just had a mega car. You know we were so quick on 300 and obviously on the 350 it was there for the taking.”Jake Dennis shared a few pictures from the podium celebrations with champagne on Instagram. He wrote: “P3. Championship leader. One round. One goal. London… let’s do this.”Reacting to his post, a fan wrote: “So deserved mate! Be cheering you on to bring it home in London!” Another called him the “Silver Surfer” for his silver merchandise for the Tokyo E-Prix.Nyck de Vries of Mahindra Racing won the Round 15 race on Sunday, with Nick Cassidy of Citroen Racing finishing second.Dennis now leads the Drivers' Standings with 146 points. Jaguar TCS Racing's Mitch Evans is just two points behind on 144, while Porsche driver Pascal Wehrlein has 141 points. Nissan’s Oliver Rowland is also in the title race with 132 points. Mahindra Racing driver Edoardo Mortara is fifth in the standings with 116 points.Also read: Tokyo E-Prix round-up: All the biggest moments from Formula E's thrilling night race

Article Title: Jakob Butturff cause of death update: What is known as the pro bowler dies at 32?
Article Text:
Jakob Butturff cause of death update: What is known after the pro bowler dies at 32? (Image via Getty)

Jakob Butturff cause of death remains unconfirmed after sudden death

Jakob Butturff cause of death update

Who was Jakob Butturff? PBA champion and Team USA star leaves behind lasting legacy

The bowling world is mourning the loss of professional bowler Jakob Butturff, who died on Friday, July 31, at the age of 32. The news shocked fans and fellow players, with many sharing heartfelt tributes for one of the sport’s most recognizable names. While social media has been filled with claims about what may have caused his death, no official cause has been announced so far. The lack of confirmed information has only added to the sadness, as the bowling community remembers Butturff not only for his success on the lanes but also for the person he was away from the game.As tributes continued to pour in, many people also searched for answers about what happened to Butturff.At this time, no official cause of death has been released by his family or the Professional Bowlers Association (PBA).A post on X claimed that Butturff had suffered an apparent heart attack, citing information that was said to have come from Joe Nolan’s Facebook page. However, the claim came from an unverified account and has not been confirmed by the PBA, Butturff’s family, or any other official source. Because of that, there is no verified information about what caused his death.The PBA announced Butturff’s passing and shared a statement from commissioner Tom Clark.“Jakob was one of the most unique players in PBA history. Fans marveled at his delivery, as he rode a wave of strikes into becoming a top player in the sport, capable of winning at any time, in any event. Jakob was kind, he was respectful, and he was a champion. He will never be forgotten. Our hearts are with all Butters touched on his one-of-a-kind journey.”Apparel company H5G Brands also paid tribute, writing:“Today, we are all Jakob fans.The bowling community has lost one of its own far too soon. Jakob’s talent, passion, and impact on our sport will never be forgotten.From everyone at H5G Brands, we extend our deepest condolences to Jakob Butturff’s family, friends, teammates, sponsors, and everyone whose lives he touched. Our thoughts and prayers are with you during this incredibly difficult time.Rest easy, Jakob. Your legacy will live on in the sport you loved and in the countless lives you inspired.Rest in Peace, Jakob Butturff. 1994–2026.”Professional bowler Tom Hess added:“A very sad day in our sport. RIP Jakob. Gone far too soon!!”Butturff built a successful career through years of consistent performances on the PBA Tour. Originally from Arizona, he also lived in Las Vegas and Binghamton, New York.His breakthrough came in 2016, and he soon established himself as one of the sport’s top bowlers. During his career, he won nine regional titles in a single season, was named both West Region and Northwest Region Player of the Year, and finished with 27 PBA Regional Tour titles.He also represented Team USA seven times, helping the country win multiple gold and silver medals in international competition.Fans remembered him not just for his unusual bowling style but also for his personality.“So sad to hear about Jakob Butturffs passing. Was super nice the few times I interacted with him, and loved watching him bowl. Rest in peace,” one fan wrote.Another posted:“Absolutely shocking news to hear that professional bowler Jakob Butturff has passed away at age 32. He was an incredible, unique bowler, and I’m at a complete loss for words right now. A massive loss for the bowling community.”A third added:“Jakob Butturff passed away today, the bowling community lost a good one.”
Article Summary: Jakob butturff died on friday, july 31, at the age of 32. No official cause of death has been released by his family or the pba. Article Title: 'One day he could captain India': Selectors explain why 15-year-old Vaibhav Sooryavanshi was named East Zone vice-captain
Article Text:
Vaibhav Sooryavanshi (ANI Photo)

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

The East Zone selectors have defended their decision to appoint 15-year-old Vaibhav Sooryavanshi as vice-captain for the upcoming Duleep Trophy, describing the move as part of a long-term leadership plan rather than an indication of the team's pecking order.While Ishan Kishan 's appointment as captain was widely expected, the decision to hand the vice-captaincy to Sooryavanshi drew attention, especially with experienced campaigners such as Abhimanyu Easwaran Mohammed Shami and Mukesh Kumar also part of the squad.Sooryavanshi has featured in only eight first-class matches for Bihar, while Easwaran has played 113 first-class games and previously captained Bengal, India A and other representative sides.Explaining the reasoning behind the decision, Manish Vardhan, Jharkhand's representative on the East Zone selection committee, said the move was aimed at helping the youngster understand leadership from close quarters."We are not thinking about the present alone," Vardhan told Cricinfo. "A vice-captain gets to observe the captain closely and understand how a team is run. We wanted Vaibhav to be more involved with the group because we think it will help him as he develops."He's an extremely talented cricketer and is maturing steadily. Giving him this responsibility is another part of that process."Vardhan also clarified that Sooryavanshi's appointment does not automatically make him the stand-in captain if Kishan is unavailable.Although the selectors have not discussed that possibility, he suggested that an experienced player would likely take charge while Sooryavanshi continued as vice-captain.According to Vardhan, the committee's thinking behind appointing Kishan as captain was also based on long-term planning, with both Kishan and Sooryavanshi viewed as players capable of remaining in India's setup for many years."The vice-captain's role isn't about status," Vardhan said. "It's about what a young player can learn while working alongside the captain."Former Odisha cricketer and current selector-coach Pravanjan Mullick echoed those views, pointing out that Sooryavanshi has already served as Bihar's vice-captain in first-class cricket."Ishan is the captain and, as wicketkeeper, he is involved in every phase of the game," Mullick told Cricinfo. "This gives Vaibhav an opportunity to understand leadership without putting the responsibility of captaining the side on him. We want him to grow, maybe one day he could even captain India. That's the thought behind giving him the vice-captaincy."Cricinfo also reported that Easwaran was intentionally not considered for the vice-captain's role. The selection committee reportedly felt it would not be appropriate for the vastly experienced batter to serve as deputy to the comparatively inexperienced Kishan.
Article Summary: The east zone selectors have defended their decision to appoint 15-year-old vaibhav sooryavanshi as vice-captain for the upcoming duleep trophy. Manish vardhan, jharkhand's representative on the east zone selection committee, said the move was aimed at helping the youngster understand leadership from close quarters.

Article Title: Fallout in West Indies camp? Alzarri Joseph hits back at Daren Sammy over 'declined selection' claim
Article Text:
Alzarri Joseph and Daren Sammy (Agency Image)

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

West Indies fast bowler Alzarri Joseph has responded to head coach Daren Sammy's comments regarding his absence from the ongoing home Test series against Pakistan, insisting that the public narrative surrounding his decision lacked important context.When Cricket West Indies announced the squad for the two-match series, the board stated that Joseph would miss the matches due to personal reasons. However, Sammy later told reporters that the pacer had been selected but chose not to accept the call-up, saying Joseph had "declined selection."Speaking on the Antigua Observer's Good Morning Jojo Sports Show, Joseph said Sammy's remarks created an unnecessary perception about his commitment to the team."We had a chat, myself and the head coach. I've also had a chat with CWI, and if you realise the statement CWI released said personal reasons. Mr Sammy, being around for a long time, he knows exactly what that statement would have done so, to be honest, I have nothing to say to Mr Sammy in terms of his statement," Joseph said."As I said, he knows exactly what that statement would have done and the narrative it would have pushed in the public.Obviously, I've been out for an entire year. I haven't played at international intensity for so long after having a second stress fracture," Joseph added.The 29-year-old explained that his decision was influenced by concerns over his physical condition after recently returning from a lengthy injury layoff.“We spoke about me playing the two Test matches here, playing five back-to-back ODIs [against New Zealand earlier this month], and how my body was feeling, and I knew to myself, my body was not ready to go into another Test series. So, the statement in itself is controversial, without context,” he said.Joseph spent close to a year on the sidelines after suffering a second stress fracture in his lower back, an injury that ruled him out of the West Indies' tours of India and New Zealand. He only returned to international cricket during the Test series against Sri Lanka earlier this year.Having only recently resumed playing at the highest level, the right-arm quick said he wanted to carefully manage his workload to avoid another setback.The contrasting explanations from Joseph and Sammy have also sparked discussion over the state of their relationship. The fast bowler, however, insisted that personal equations would not affect his commitment to representing the West Indies."I'm a professional, so I'm going to go to work. I am representing the West Indies. I'm not representing Daren Sammy, so for me, I'm neither here nor there in terms of a relationship," Joseph said.“I don't go there to make friends. I go there to work and do a job and represent the people of the West Indies,” he added.
Article Summary: West indies fast bowler alzarri joseph has responded to daren sammy's comments regarding his absence from the ongoing test series against pakistan. Joseph said sammy's remarks created an unnecessary perception about his commitment to the team.

Article Title: “Three-against-one situation”: El Rubius opens up on being “targeted” in MrBeast’s viral $1M challenge

El Rubius reflects on a tough and “unfair” exit

But for a 25-year-old techie the craze for IPL tickets for RCB vs CSK turned too costly and he was duped for a massive Rs. 1.46 lakh.The techie, a resident of B Narayanapura, fell into a trap by a post posted by a fraudster who posed himself as a ticket seller on Instagram.As per a report in Deccan Herald, the techie alleged in a complaint to Mahadevapura Police that an individual claiming to be Sumit Biswal promised he could arrange IPL tickets along with food coupons.As per the techie, Biswal was introduced him as a senior supervisor for ticket counter at M Chinnaswamy Stadium"He asked me to come near the stadium gate number 10, saying someone would deliver the tickets within minutes, and even sent an email confirmation to gain my trust," the complainant told Deccan Herald."Initially, I agreed to buy two tickets for Rs 3,700 each,but he kept asking for more money under various pretexts such as refundable security deposits, additional ID cards and food coupons.Trusting him, I made multiple payments - even using my mother’s bank account after exhausting my own limits—and ended up transferring around Rs 1.46 lakh," he added.Bhuvneshwar Kumar’s incisive spell of 3-41, coming after a marauding batting show from Tim David, Rajat Patidar and Devdutt Padikkal, propelled Royal Challengers Bengaluru (RCB) to a commanding 43-run victory over Chennai Super Kings (CSK) in their IPL 2026 encounter at the M Chinnaswamy Stadium on Sunday.The contest saw RCB’s batting unit dismantle CSK’s attack with relentless hitting, as David’s 70 not out off just 25 balls and Patidar’s unbeaten 48 off only 19 balls provided for the late fireworks after Padikkal’s fluent 50 off 29 balls had set the tone for the daunting total.Their combined effort lifted RCB to a daunting 250/3, thus setting a new record for highest total in IPL 2026. In reply, CSK faltered under scoreboard pressure, with Sarfaraz Khan’s 50 off 24 balls and Prashant Veer’s 43 the lone acts of resistance amid a string of failures from the top order.Bhuvneshwar was at his disciplined best and even crossed the 200-mark in terms of wickets in IPL, with others also chipping in as CSK were bowled out for 207 in 19.4 overs. The comprehensive win also meant RCB have registered four consecutive triumphs over CSK for the first time in the IPL’s history.
